mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assessment_diagnostic_attempt (student_user_id, stage, total_questions, correct_count, score_percent, category_scores_json, strengths_json, weaknesses_json, recommended_code, interests_json, created_time) VALUES (#{studentUserId}, #{stage}, #{totalQuestions}, #{correctCount}, #{scorePercent}, #{categoryScoresJson}, #{strengthsJson}, #{weaknessesJson}, #{recommendedCode}, #{interestsJson}, #{createdTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM assessment_diagnostic_attempt WHERE student_user_id = #{studentUserId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
